entries.name: x-formspec-email
entries.description: Email address with RFC 5321 simplified validation. Extends string with a pattern that covers the vast majority of real-world addresses without rejecting uncommon but valid ones.

entries.name: x-formspec-phone
entries.description: International phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +14155551234). Stored as a string to preserve the leading plus sign and any leading zeros in country codes.

entries.name: x-formspec-phone-nanp
entries.description: North American phone number in (###) ###-#### display format. For US/Canada/Caribbean forms where E.164 is unnecessarily strict. Stored with punctuation for human readability.

entries.name: x-formspec-postal-code-us
entries.description: US ZIP code in 5-digit or ZIP+4 format. Stored as string to preserve leading zeros (e.g. 01234).

entries.name: x-formspec-percentage
entries.description: Percentage value stored as a decimal number 0–100 (not 0–1). Renderers should display a '%' suffix. Precision defaults to 2 decimal places.

entries.name: x-formspec-currency-usd
entries.description: US Dollar amount stored as a non-negative decimal with 2-digit precision. For forms that always use USD and don't need the full money composite type.

entries.name: x-formspec-ssn
entries.description: US Social Security Number in ###-##-#### format. Renderers should mask display (showing only last 4 digits) for privacy. Stored with hyphens.

entries.name: x-formspec-ein
entries.description: US Employer Identification Number in ##-####### format.

entries.name: x-formspec-credit-card
entries.description: Credit/debit card number stored as digits only (no spaces or hyphens). Renderers should format with spaces for readability. Validated by length (13–19 digits) and Luhn checksum.

entries.name: x-formspec-color-hex
entries.description: Hex color code in #RRGGBB or #RGB format. Renderers may present a color picker.

entries.name: x-formspec-slug
entries.description: URL-safe slug: lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens. Must start and end with a letter or digit. Useful for identifiers, usernames, and URL paths.

entries.name: x-formspec-ipv4
entries.description: IPv4 address in dotted-decimal notation (e.g. 192.168.1.1). Pattern validates format; does not restrict to routable addresses.

entries.name: x-formspec-url
entries.description: HTTPS URL with domain validation. Pattern enforces https:// scheme, valid hostname labels, optional port, and optional path. Use a manual constraint with matches() if http:// is also needed.

entries.name: x-formspec-luhn
entries.description: Validates that a numeric string passes the Luhn checksum algorithm. Used for credit card numbers, IMEI numbers, Canadian SINs, and other identifiers that embed a check digit.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The numeric string to validate (digits only, no spaces or hyphens).

entries.name: x-formspec-age
entries.description: Calculates age in whole years from a birth date to today (or an optional reference date). Returns null if the birth date is in the future.

parameters.name: birthDate
parameters.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: referenceDate
parameters.description: Optional reference date. Defaults to today() if omitted.

entries.name: x-formspec-mask
entries.description: Masks a string value for display, revealing only the last N characters and replacing the rest with a mask character. Useful for displaying partial SSNs, account numbers, etc.

parameters.name: visibleChars
parameters.description: Number of trailing characters to leave visible.

parameters.name: maskChar
parameters.description: Character to use for masking. Defaults to '*'.

entries.name: x-formspec-common
entries.description: Module bundling the Formspec common extensions — widely useful data types, constraints, and functions that complement the core specification. Renamed from `category: namespace` to `category: module` per ADR 0150 §4.1.

entries.name: x-formspec-plural-category
entries.description: CLDR cardinal plural category function. Returns 'zero', 'one', 'two', 'few', 'many', or 'other' based on CLDR plural rules for the given count and locale. Required for languages with non-trivial plural forms (Arabic, Polish, Czech, etc.).

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The numeric value to classify into a plural category.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Optional BCP 47 locale code. When omitted, uses the active locale.
